text:
Talia Benson: doc status check-in for profile pack 🙏 we’re close but not done. can folks confirm review ETA / what’s blocking? target is “docs ready” before go/no-go.

Talia Benson: Links:
- Confluence overview: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/RT/Profile+Pack+Overview
- Schema + selection rules: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/RT/Profile+Schema+and+Selection
- Expected behavior (H100): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/RT/Expected+Behavior+H100
- Expected behavior (L40S): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/RT/Expected+Behavior+L40S
- Expected behavior (B200 preview): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/RT/Expected+Behavior+B200
- Troubleshooting/runbook draft: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/RT/Profile+Pack+Rollout+and+Troubleshooting

Elliot Price: thx. overall structure looks good. we’re missing 2 things that reviewers keep asking for:
1) “expected behavior” tables w/ actual numbers / ranges (even if provisional) + what bucket they apply to
2) troubleshooting section needs “if you see X metric do Y” mapping (kernel fallback rate, queueing, OOM/frag)

Kira Thompson: +1. also the rollout/runbook page needs explicit “kill switch semantics” and the exact knobs that get reverted (profile_version pin vs individual overrides). right now it’s implied.

Mateo Alvarez: please keep the expected behavior tables “bounded” and not overpromise. ranges + disclaimers are ok, but we need something customer-facing teams can reason about.

Sean Gallagher: from SRE side: we can’t sign off until the troubleshooting section calls out the SLO gates we’re using + where to look in dashboards. today it’s missing “what blocks rollout” in one place.

Allison Grant: I can add links to the Runtime Profiles dashboard panels once the metric names are finalized in the doc. right now H100 page references `kernel_choice` but scheduler queue metric is still inconsistent (`scheduler_queue_ms` vs `queue_ms`).

Omar El-Sayed: metrics naming is settled in code (post-24935): `scheduler_queue_ms` (hist), `runtime_kernel_fallback_total` (counter), `kv_compaction_ms` (hist), `kv_frag_estimate` (gauge-ish). doc needs update.

Noah Patel: re: schema page — can someone add a “selection precedence” diagram? lots of confusion about: fleet default -> control-plane pin -> customer override -> runtime guardrail clamp.

Connor O'Brien: release-wise: doc links must be stable + “last reviewed” stamps. also need a small changelog blurb for runtime-1.22. I can handle release note formatting once content is final.

Irene Choi: infra review: H100/L40S sections need a paragraph on driver/CUDA expectations + what happens if mismatch (warn vs hard fail). B200 must be hard fail unless explicit profile pin (as discussed).

Hiro Tanaka: kernel review: H100 expected behavior page still has TODO: “v3 attention kernel fallback rules” — please include the 2-3 triggers (context len threshold, dtype/quant config incompat, driver mismatch) + what to expect if fallback occurs (perf hit, metrics).

Sofia Ivanova: scheduler review: the mixed workload buckets section is there but missing the “why” + tradeoff. we should explicitly say: prioritizing decode reduces tail latency for chatty workloads but may reduce throughput on long-prefill batchy jobs. also add recommended queue limits per SKU.

Lauren Bishop: from Product/Dedicated: can we add a tiny “what changes for Dedicated customers” callout? i keep getting asked: "will my SLO move?" and "can i pin?". we need a canned answer + link to how to pin a profile_version + rollback.

Talia Benson: ok, converting to concrete TODOs + owners. pls react w/ :thumbsup: if you can take.
- [ ] Add expected behavior tables (p50/p95/p99 latency + tok/s ranges) per workload bucket for H100 + L40S (use benchmark matrix v1) — @Elliot Price to drive, needs inputs from @Rina Kobayashi / @Claire Dubois (I’ll ping them separately)
- [ ] Fill H100 kernel v3 fallback rules + metric names — @Hiro Tanaka
- [ ] Fill scheduler tradeoffs + queue limit recs per SKU — @Sofia Ivanova
- [ ] Add troubleshooting “symptom -> check -> action” table (kernel fallback, queueing, KV compaction/frag, OOM) — @Kira Thompson + @Omar El-Sayed
- [ ] Add infra compatibility notes (driver/CUDA, PCIe vs SXM, MIG policy) + B200 hard gate language — @Irene Choi
- [ ] Add SRE rollout gates + “what blocks rollout” section + kill switch semantics — @Sean Gallagher + @Talia Benson
- [ ] Add Dedicated customer callout + pin/rollback blurb — @Lauren Bishop
- [ ] Update metrics naming and add dashboard links — @Allison Grant
- [ ] Add precedence diagram on schema page — @Noah Patel (or I can do a quick ascii diagram if you’re slammed)

Hiro Tanaka: :thumbsup: I’ll update H100 page today. will also add a short “what changed vs v2 kernel” note and a screenshot snippet from microbench.

Sofia Ivanova: :thumbsup: I can get scheduler section in by tomorrow noon. need confirmation from Marcus on final queue caps for L40S (we lowered after OOM scare).

Omar El-Sayed: :thumbsup: can help Kira w/ troubleshooting table + include exact queries for metrics (promQL-ish) + what thresholds we consider “weird”.

Kira Thompson: :thumbsup: I’ll draft the table + the kill-switch/rollback subsection (what flips, what persists, audit log note). will ask Rafael for wording consistency with canary playbook.

Irene Choi: :thumbsup: I’ll add the driver/CUDA baseline + MIG note. B200: we should be explicit: runtime refuses to start w/ “default” selection; must pass `profile_version` and `profile_id` w/ allowlist.

Sean Gallagher: :thumbsup: I’ll drop in the SLO gate list + link to the paging vs ticket thresholds. also want a small note: “if scheduler_queue_ms p99 spikes, do NOT immediately increase batch” (we saw that bite us).

Allison Grant: :thumbsup: will add dashboard links + panel names. pls ensure docs include label set (`profile_id`, `profile_version`, `sku`, `model_family`).

Lauren Bishop: :thumbsup: will add the Dedicated callout w/ conservative language. also: can we include one sentence on how quickly a pin takes effect (next model reload vs immediate)?

Noah Patel: I can do the precedence diagram. will add a simple flow + examples:
- Hosted: fleet default only
- Dedicated: fleet default + optional customer pin (guardrailed)
- Private: helm values override w/ compatibility warnings

Talia Benson: awesome. I’m going to set “docs freeze” for go/no-go: EOD tomorrow. if you can’t hit it, comment here w/ what’s missing.

Connor O'Brien: once docs are in, pls @me for final pass so release notes can reference the canonical URLs. also need a quick “known limitations” bullet list (B200 provisional, L40S concurrency cap).

Mateo Alvarez: thanks all. pls make sure the expected behavior tables include *variance disclaimer* + “how to validate on your workload” link to benchmarking protocol. we want to avoid people treating it like an SLA.

Talia Benson: noted. I’ll add that disclaimer + link to benchmark protocol page + validation playbook. will ping again tomorrow morning for final green checks.
